⏺ Update(CLAUDE.md)
  ⎿  Added 1 line
      51  - **Free lines**: Stored as `{ id, points, lineStyle, stroke, strokeWidth, dash }` in `S.freeLines[]`. Rendered into a `<g id="free
          -lines-layer">` inside `#svg-links`. `lineStyle` is `'polyline'`, `'curve'`, or `'straight'`.
      52  - **Undo**: `pushUndo()` snapshots `S.nodes`, `S.links`, `S.freeLines` (shallow copy), capped at 10. `undo()` pops the top snapshot
          , clears DOM, and re-renders all nodes and lines.
      53  - **Persistence**: Auto-saved to a per-tab `localStorage` key `code-canvas-v1-{TAB_ID}` on every change (stale entries from closed
          tabs purged after 30 days). Import/export uses JSON with the full state schema.
      54 +- **Cross-tab clipboard**: Copy/cut also writes to the shared `localStorage` key `code-canvas-clipboard` (no TAB suffix). Paste rea
         +ds from that key first, so Cmd+C in one tab followed by Cmd+V in another tab works. Paste shifts the in-memory clipboard for offset
         + stacking but does not overwrite the shared key.
      55  - **Git integration**: Fetches raw file content from GitHub (`raw.githubusercontent.com`) to populate code blocks. Commit hash auto
          -resolved via GitHub API (`api.github.com`). Multiple repos configurable via `S.globalConfig.repositories[]`.
      56
      57  ## Node types

     Plan: Per-node Font Customization (family + size)

     Context

     Users want to customize the font for each node independently. Code block, bubble, and frame nodes currently have fonts hardcoded in CSS. The
     color system is a well-established pattern to follow: per-node property stored in data, CSS custom properties applied by applyNodeColor(), and
     a picker UI inside the edit menu (.edit-menu inside .edit-menu-wrap).

     Approach

     Mirror the color pattern exactly:
     - Add fontFamily and fontSize fields to each node's data object
     - Add applyNodeFont(n, el) that sets CSS custom properties on the node element
     - Add fontControlsHTML(n) that renders two <select> dropdowns in the edit menu
     - Update CSS rules to use the custom properties (with original values as fallbacks)
     - Wire up change event listeners in the three edit render functions

     Font Presets

     Code block (monospace)

     ┌────────────────┬────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
     │       id       │     label      │                              CSS family                               │
     ├────────────────┼────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ default        │ Default        │ 'Source Code Pro', 'Menlo', 'Cascadia Mono', 'Consolas', ...monospace │
     ├────────────────┼────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ jetbrains-mono │ JetBrains Mono │ 'JetBrains Mono', monospace                                           │
     ├────────────────┼────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ fira-code      │ Fira Code      │ 'Fira Code', monospace                                                │
     ├────────────────┼────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ menlo          │ Menlo          │ 'Menlo', monospace                                                    │
     ├────────────────┼────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ cascadia-code  │ Cascadia Code  │ 'Cascadia Code', 'Cascadia Mono', monospace                           │
     ├────────────────┼────────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ consolas       │ Consolas       │ 'Consolas', monospace                                                 │
     └────────────────┴────────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

     Font sizes (px): 10, 11, 12, 12.5 (default), 13, 14, 16

     Bubble & Frame (sans-serif)

     ┌─────────┬─────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
     │   id    │  label  │                        CSS family                         │
     ├─────────┼─────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ default │ Default │ -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif │

     │ inter   │ Inter   │ 'Inter', sans-serif                                       │

     └─────────┴─────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

     Frame font sizes: 10, 11, 12 (default), 13, 14

     ├───────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

     8. editHTML(n) (line 844): insert ${fontControlsHTML(n)} inside .edit-menu, after ${colorSwatchesHTML(...)}
     9. renderNode() edit-mode handler (around line 280): add listeners for .sel-font-family and .sel-font-size change events → update
     n.fontFamily/n.fontSize, call applyNodeFont(n, el), scheduleSave()
     10. bubbleEditHTML(n) (line 461): insert ${fontControlsHTML(n)} inside .edit-menu
     11. renderBubbleContent() (line 484 area): add same font change listeners
     12. renderFrameContent() (line 701): insert ${fontControlsHTML(n)} inside .edit-menu; add font change listeners (line 715 area)

     Persistence: saveState() already spreads all node fields; loadState() requires no changes — missing fontFamily/fontSize fields on old saves
     fall back to defaults in applyNodeFont.

     - Line 197–198 (.node-body pre): change to font-size: var(--node-font-size, 12.5px) and font-family: var(--node-font-family, 'Source Code Pro',
      ...monospace)
     - Line 214–215 (.node-body textarea): same variables
     - .bubble-text (line ~662): font-size: var(--bubble-font-size, 13px) and font-family: var(--bubble-font-family, -apple-system, ...)
     - .bubble-textarea (line ~669): same variables
     - .frame-label (lines 86, 95): add font-size: var(--frame-font-size, 12px) and font-family: var(--frame-font-family, -apple-system, ...)

     [ •••  ] → opens:
     ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
     │ ● ● ● ● ● ● ● ●  (color swatches)    │
     │ [Font Family ▼]  [Size ▼]             │
     │ [⬇ Fetch]  [📦 codesnippetd]          │
     │ [▲ Bring to Front] [▼ Send to Back]   │
     └───────────────────────────────────────┘

     Bubble and frame menus: same structure minus Fetch/codesnippetd buttons.

     Verification

     1. Open canvas.html via local server
     2. Add a code block, open edit menu (•••) → confirm Font Family and Size dropdowns appear
     3. Change font family to JetBrains Mono → code renders in JetBrains Mono immediately
     4. Change font size to 14px → code text grows
     5. Click Done, re-open Edit → dropdowns retain the chosen values
     6. Export JSON → confirm fontFamily/fontSize fields present in node data
     7. Import the JSON → fonts restored correctly
     8. Repeat for bubble and frame nodes
     9. Open an old export (without font fields) → nodes render with defaults, no errors

      206 +// FONT HELPERS
      207 +// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
      208 +function applyNodeFont(n, el) {
      209 +  const type = n.type === 'bubble' ? 'bubble' : n.type === 'frame' ? 'frame' : 'code';
      210 +  const preset = FONT_PRESETS[type].find(p => p.id === (n.fontFamily ?? 'default')) ?? FONT_PRESETS[type][0];
      211 +  if (type === 'code') {
      212 +    el.style.setProperty('--node-font-family', preset.family);
      213 +    el.style.setProperty('--node-font-size',   (n.fontSize ?? 12.5) + 'px');
      214 +  } else if (type === 'bubble') {
      215 +    el.style.setProperty('--bubble-font-family', preset.family);
      216 +    el.style.setProperty('--bubble-font-size',   (n.fontSize ?? 13) + 'px');
      217 +  } else {
      218 +    el.style.setProperty('--frame-font-family', preset.family);
      219 +    el.style.setProperty('--frame-font-size',   (n.fontSize ?? 12) + 'px');
      220 +  }
      221 +}
      222 +
      223 +function fontControlsHTML(n) {
      224 +  const type = n.type === 'bubble' ? 'bubble' : n.type === 'frame' ? 'frame' : 'code';
      225 +  const currentFamily = n.fontFamily ?? 'default';
      226 +  const currentSize   = n.fontSize  ?? (type === 'code' ? 12.5 : type === 'bubble' ? 13 : 12);
      227 +  const familyOpts = FONT_PRESETS[type].map(p =>
      228 +    `<option value="${p.id}"${p.id === currentFamily ? ' selected' : ''}>${p.label}</option>`
      229 +  ).join('');
      230 +  const sizeOpts = FONT_SIZES[type].map(s =>
      231 +    `<option value="${s}"${s === currentSize ? ' selected' : ''}>${s}px</option>`
      232 +  ).join('');
      233 +  return `<div class="font-controls">
      234 +    <select class="sel-font-family" title="Font family">${familyOpts}</select>
      235 +    <select class="sel-font-size" title="Font size">${sizeOpts}</select>
      236 +  </div>`;
      237 +}

  1. code block — 編集モードで ••• → フォントファミリー選択（Default/JetBrains Mono/Fira Code/Menlo/Cascadia
  Code/Consolas）とサイズ選択（10〜16px）が表示される
  2. bubble — 同様に ••• メニューにフォント選択が表示される
  3. frame — 同様にフォント選択可能。ラベルテキストとinputフィールドの両方が変更される
  4. 後方互換 — 既存の保存データは fontFamily/fontSize が未定義でも applyNodeFont がデフォルト値にフォールバックするため問題なし
  5. 永続化 — saveState() は全ノードフィールドをそのまま保存するので、変更後の値は自動で保存・復元される

          す。右クリックでリンクの色・太さ・破線スタイルを変更できます。
      14 -- **吹き出し**: 移動可能な尾部を持つコメント吹き出しを追加できます。吹き出しヘッダーのチェックボックスで尾部の表示・非表示を切り替

          変更できます。
      17  - **アンドゥ**: Cmd/Ctrl+Z で直前の操作を取り消せます（スナップショット方式、最大10ステップ）。
      18  - **無限キャンバス**: Miro風のナビゲーション（ドラッグでパン、Cmd+ドラッグでズーム、v/hでモード切替）。

❯ 前から失敗するテストについて調査して

  Searched for 4 patterns, read 4 files (ctrl+o to expand)

⏺ 原因が分かりました。

  問題の連鎖:

  1. "restores viewport position and scale" テストが S.vp = { x: 123, y: 456, scale: 1.5 } を設定して restoreFromStorage() で復元したまま終了
  2. resetState() は loadState({ nodes: [], links: [], nid: 1, lid: 1 }) を呼ぶが、vp フィールドがないので loadState 内の if (data.vp)
  Object.assign(S.vp, data.vp) が実行されず、S.vp がリセットされない
  3. Copy/Paste テストが汚染された S.vp で実行される

  S.vp = { x:123, y:456, scale:1.5 } で何が起きるか:

  visBottom = (768 - 456) / 1.5 = 208
  minY (node top + offset) = 200 + 30 = 230 > 208 → offScreen = true

  ペーストロジックが「画面外なので中央に移動」を発動し、

  visCX = (-82 + 600.67) / 2 = 259.33
  dx = 259.33 - 345 = -85.67
  pasted.x = 100 + 30 + (-85.67) = 44.33...  ← テストで確認された値

  修正: resetState() に vp リセットを追加する。

  └──────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  修正: resetState() の loadState 呼び出しに vp: { x: 0, y: 0, scale: 1 } を渡すだけでテスト間の独立性が確保された。

╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌╌
 Plan: Split canvas.js into Smaller Modules

 Context

 canvas.js is 3,308 lines and hard to navigate, maintain, and test in isolation. canvas-utils.js (358 lines) and canvas-dialogs.js (924 lines) have
  already been extracted. The goal is to reduce canvas.js to ~900 lines by extracting 4 new modules, following the same dependency-injection
 pattern used by canvas-dialogs.js.

 No build step; ES modules must work directly in browser.

 ---
 Architecture Decision

 Central pattern: initXxx(deps) → returns object of functions

 Each new module exports a single initXxx(deps) function. canvas.js calls them in order and gathers the returned functions. The S object and core
 utilities (pushUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus, s2c, ndEl) stay in canvas.js and are passed into every module via deps.

 No circular ES-module imports — every new file imports only from canvas-utils.js (pure, no side effects).

 Forwarding closures break chicken-and-egg problems:
 const deps = {
   pushUndo: (...a) => pushUndo(...a),   // defined later in canvas.js
   renderNode: (...a) => renderNode(...a), // defined by an earlier initXxx call
   ...
 };

 ---
 Prep: Move shared constants/helpers to canvas-utils.js

 Before splitting, move these from canvas.js into canvas-utils.js (they have no external dependencies):

 ┌───────────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │                Symbol                 │ Currently at (approx line) │                        Why move                        │
 ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ svgE(tag, attrs)                      │ ~1648 (LINKS)              │ Used by both links and free-lines modules              │
 ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ c2s(cx, cy)                           │ ~1564 (LINKS)              │ Logical pair of s2c; used by both links and free-lines │
 ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ LINK_COLORS, LINK_WIDTHS, LINK_DASHES │ ~1700s (LINK CTX)          │ Pure data; shared by link and free-lines context menus │
 └───────────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

 ---
 New Files

 1. canvas-node-rendering.js (~410 lines)

 Sections moved: HIGHLIGHT (125-163) + COLOR HELPERS (164-204) + FONT HELPERS (205-256) + NODE RENDERING core HTML builders (257-507 partial) +
 Z-ORDER (1228-1274)

 Exported: initNodeRendering(deps) → { renderNode }

 All sub-functions (buildCodeHTML, colorSwatchesHTML, fontControlsHTML, zOrderMenuHTML, applyNodeColor, applyNodeFont, bindZOrderButtons,
 renderBubbleContent, renderFrameContent, editHTML, viewHTML, etc.) are module-private.

 deps it receives:
 S, canvas, ndEl, s2c,
 pushUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus,
 startEdit, stopEdit, autoFitNode, selectNode,
 toggleMultiSel, clearMultiSel, removeNode,
 renderLinks, renderBubbleTail, renderAnchoredBubbleTails,
 openFetchDialog, openCodeSnippetdDialog,
 createLink, jumpTo, showAnchorCtx, showTailAnchorCtx, removeLink, attachTailToText

 ---
 2. canvas-free-lines.js (~320 lines)

 Sections moved: FREE LINES (1893-2199)

 Exported: initFreeLines(deps) → { renderFreeLines, addFreeLine, removeFreeLine, selectFreeLine, enterLineDrawMode, exitLineDrawMode,
 finishDrawingLine, showLineCtx, hideLineCtx }

 deps it receives:
 S, svgE, c2s, s2c,
 LINK_COLORS, LINK_WIDTHS, LINK_DASHES,
 pushUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus, selectNode, renderLinks

 ---
 3. canvas-links.js (~480 lines)

     Plan: Split canvas.js into Smaller Modules

     Context

     canvas.js is 3,308 lines and hard to navigate, maintain, and test in isolation. canvas-utils.js (358 lines) and canvas-dialogs.js (924 lines)
     have already been extracted. The goal is to reduce canvas.js to ~900 lines by extracting 4 new modules, following the same dependency-injection
      pattern used by canvas-dialogs.js.

     No build step; ES modules must work directly in browser.

     ---
     Architecture Decision

     Central pattern: initXxx(deps) → returns object of functions

     Each new module exports a single initXxx(deps) function. canvas.js calls them in order and gathers the returned functions. The S object and
     core utilities (pushUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus, s2c, ndEl) stay in canvas.js and are passed into every module via deps.

     No circular ES-module imports — every new file imports only from canvas-utils.js (pure, no side effects).

     Forwarding closures break chicken-and-egg problems:
     const deps = {
       pushUndo: (...a) => pushUndo(...a),   // defined later in canvas.js
       renderNode: (...a) => renderNode(...a), // defined by an earlier initXxx call
       ...
     };

     ---
     Prep: Move shared constants/helpers to canvas-utils.js

     Before splitting, move these from canvas.js into canvas-utils.js (they have no external dependencies):

     ┌───────────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
     │                Symbol                 │ Currently at (approx line) │                        Why move                        │
     ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ svgE(tag, attrs)                      │ ~1648 (LINKS)              │ Used by both links and free-lines modules              │
     ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ c2s(cx, cy)                           │ ~1564 (LINKS)              │ Logical pair of s2c; used by both links and free-lines │
     ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ LINK_COLORS, LINK_WIDTHS, LINK_DASHES │ ~1700s (LINK CTX)          │ Pure data; shared by link and free-lines context menus │
     └───────────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

     ---

     1. canvas-node-rendering.js (~410 lines)

     Sections moved: HIGHLIGHT (125-163) + COLOR HELPERS (164-204) + FONT HELPERS (205-256) + NODE RENDERING core HTML builders (257-507 partial) +
     Z-ORDER (1228-1274)

     Exported: initNodeRendering(deps) → { renderNode }

     All sub-functions (buildCodeHTML, colorSwatchesHTML, fontControlsHTML, zOrderMenuHTML, applyNodeColor, applyNodeFont, bindZOrderButtons,
     renderBubbleContent, renderFrameContent, editHTML, viewHTML, etc.) are module-private.

     openFetchDialog, openCodeSnippetdDialog,
     createLink, jumpTo, showAnchorCtx, showTailAnchorCtx, removeLink, attachTailToText

     ---

     finishDrawingLine, showLineCtx, hideLineCtx }

     Plan: Split canvas.js into Smaller Modules

     Context

     canvas.js is 3,308 lines and hard to navigate, maintain, and test in isolation. canvas-utils.js (358 lines) and canvas-dialogs.js (924 lines)
     have already been extracted. The goal is to reduce canvas.js to ~900 lines by extracting 4 new modules, following the same dependency-injection
      pattern used by canvas-dialogs.js.

     No build step; ES modules must work directly in browser.

     ---
     Architecture Decision

     Central pattern: initXxx(deps) → returns object of functions

     Each new module exports a single initXxx(deps) function. canvas.js calls them in order and gathers the returned functions. The S object and
     core utilities (pushUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus, s2c, ndEl) stay in canvas.js and are passed into every module via deps.

     No circular ES-module imports — every new file imports only from canvas-utils.js (pure, no side effects).

     Forwarding closures break chicken-and-egg problems:
     const deps = {
       pushUndo: (...a) => pushUndo(...a),   // defined later in canvas.js
       renderNode: (...a) => renderNode(...a), // defined by an earlier initXxx call
       ...
     };

     ---
     Prep: Move shared constants/helpers to canvas-utils.js

     Before splitting, move these from canvas.js into canvas-utils.js (they have no external dependencies):

     ┌───────────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
     │                Symbol                 │ Currently at (approx line) │                        Why move                        │
     ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ svgE(tag, attrs)                      │ ~1648 (LINKS)              │ Used by both links and free-lines modules              │
     ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ c2s(cx, cy)                           │ ~1564 (LINKS)              │ Logical pair of s2c; used by both links and free-lines │
     ├───────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ LINK_COLORS, LINK_WIDTHS, LINK_DASHES │ ~1700s (LINK CTX)          │ Pure data; shared by link and free-lines context menus │
     └───────────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

     ---
     New Files

     1. canvas-node-rendering.js (~410 lines)

     Sections moved: HIGHLIGHT (125-163) + COLOR HELPERS (164-204) + FONT HELPERS (205-256) + NODE RENDERING core HTML builders (257-507 partial) +
     Z-ORDER (1228-1274)

     Exported: initNodeRendering(deps) → { renderNode }

     All sub-functions (buildCodeHTML, colorSwatchesHTML, fontControlsHTML, zOrderMenuHTML, applyNodeColor, applyNodeFont, bindZOrderButtons,
     renderBubbleContent, renderFrameContent, editHTML, viewHTML, etc.) are module-private.

     deps it receives:
     S, canvas, ndEl, s2c,
     pushUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus,
     startEdit, stopEdit, autoFitNode, selectNode,
     toggleMultiSel, clearMultiSel, removeNode,
     renderLinks, renderBubbleTail, renderAnchoredBubbleTails,
     openFetchDialog, openCodeSnippetdDialog,
     createLink, jumpTo, showAnchorCtx, showTailAnchorCtx, removeLink, attachTailToText

     ---
     2. canvas-free-lines.js (~320 lines)

     Sections moved: FREE LINES (1893-2199)

     Exported: initFreeLines(deps) → { renderFreeLines, addFreeLine, removeFreeLine, selectFreeLine, enterLineDrawMode, exitLineDrawMode,
     finishDrawingLine, showLineCtx, hideLineCtx }

     deps it receives:
     S, svgE, c2s, s2c,
     LINK_COLORS, LINK_WIDTHS, LINK_DASHES,
     pushUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus, selectNode, renderLinks

     ---
     3. canvas-links.js (~480 lines)

     Sections moved: LINKS (1538-1653) + LINK MODE (1654-1672) + TAIL ATTACH MODE (1673-1689) + LINK CONTEXT MENU (1690-1892) + LINK PREVIEW
     (2200-2233) + TEXT SELECTION → LINK (2234-2347)

     Exported: initLinks(deps) → { renderLinks, createLink, removeLink, enterLinkMode, exitLinkMode, enterTailAttachMode, exitTailAttachMode,
     showAnchorCtx, hideAnchorCtx, showTailAnchorCtx, hideTailAnchorCtx, targetEntryPoint }

     Module-level document.addEventListener calls (for hiding context menus) must be placed inside initLinks() body, not at module-eval time.

     deps it receives:
     S, wrap, svgLinks, linkTip, linkTipLink, linkTipNewBlock, linkTipAttachTail,
     linkCtx, linkCtxDel, linkCtxColors, linkCtxWidths, linkCtxDashes,
     anchorCtx, anchorCtxLink, anchorCtxNewBlock, anchorCtxDelAll,
     tailAnchorCtx, tailAnchorCtxDetach, linkPreviewEl,
     renderNode, addNode, selectNode, startEdit,
     pushUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus,
     s2c, c2s, svgE,
     edgePoint, anchorFpFromSide

     ---
     4. canvas-nodes.js (~720 lines)

     Sections moved: BUBBLE NODE (508-783) + FRAME NODE (784-1227) + node lifecycle functions from NODE RENDERING (addNode, removeNode, selectNode,
     toggleMultiSel, clearMultiSel, autoFitNode, startEdit, stopEdit) + COPY/CUT/PASTE (1275-1537) + fitAll + jumpTo

     Exported: initNodes(deps) → { addNode, addBubble, addFrame, removeNode, selectNode, toggleMultiSel, clearMultiSel, startEdit, stopEdit,
     autoFitNode, setupNodeEvents, setupFrameEvents, renderBubbleTail, renderAnchoredBubbleTails, attachTailToText, getSelectedIds, copyNodes,
     cutNodes, pasteNodes, fitAll, jumpTo }

     Note on _suppressUndo: Expose a suppressUndo(bool) setter from canvas.js's UNDO section and pass it into deps, instead of sharing the raw
     variable.

     deps it receives:
     S, canvas, wrap, ndEl, s2c, c2s,
     renderNode, renderLinks, renderFreeLines,
     pushUndo, suppressUndo, scheduleSave, setStatus,
     openFetchDialog, openCodeSnippetdDialog,
     enterLinkMode, enterTailAttachMode,
     showAnchorCtx, showTailAnchorCtx,
     createLink, removeLink, svgE

     ---
     canvas.js After Extraction (~900 lines)

     Retains:
     - STATE — S object
     - DOM REFS — raw element references
     - MODE — setMode, updateCursor
     - VIEWPORT — applyVP, s2c, zoom (+ c2s moved here from LINKS)
     - UTILS — setStatus, ndEl
     - UNDO — pushUndo, undo, snapshotForUndo, suppressUndo
     - PERSISTENCE — saveState, loadState, restoreFromStorage, toolbar event listeners
     - CANVAS INTERACTION — mouse/pointer handlers (uses all modules' functions)
     - INIT — async init IIFE
     - WIRING — calls to initNodeRendering, initFreeLines, initLinks, initNodes, initDialogs
     - TEST EXPORTS — globalThis.__canvasApp (shape unchanged; values sourced from module return objects)

     ---
     Extraction Order

     Extract in dependency order — lowest coupling first:

     1. Prep: move svgE, c2s, LINK_COLORS/WIDTHS/DASHES to canvas-utils.js
     2. canvas-node-rendering.js — establishes renderNode pattern; no canvas.js imports
     3. canvas-free-lines.js — fewest cross-deps; only needs svgE, c2s, renderLinks
     4. canvas-links.js — needs renderNode and addNode (from wiring), provides renderLinks back
     5. canvas-nodes.js — depends on all prior modules; extracted last

     Run npm test after each step to catch regressions immediately.

     ---
     Test Impact

     Zero changes to test files. The globalThis.__canvasApp export object in canvas.js keeps the exact same shape; values are now sourced from
     initXxx() return objects instead of local declarations. All 5 test files remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

     ---
     Verification

     After all steps:
     1. npm test — all existing tests pass
     2. open canvas.html via local server — full manual smoke test (add nodes, draw links, free lines, undo, save/restore, copy/paste cross-tab,
     dialogs)
     3. wc -l canvas*.js — confirm each file is under ~750 lines (canvas.js itself under ~950)

     ---
     Final Line Counts (estimated)

     ┌────────────────────────────────┬────────┐
     │              File              │ Lines  │
     ├────────────────────────────────┼────────┤
     │ canvas.js (reduced)            │ ~900   │
     ├────────────────────────────────┼────────┤
     │ canvas-node-rendering.js (new) │ ~410   │
     ├────────────────────────────────┼────────┤
     │ canvas-nodes.js (new)          │ ~720   │
     ├────────────────────────────────┼────────┤
     │ canvas-links.js (new)          │ ~480   │
     ├────────────────────────────────┼────────┤
     │ canvas-free-lines.js (new)     │ ~320   │
     ├────────────────────────────────┼────────┤
     │ canvas-dialogs.js (unchanged)  │ 924    │
     ├────────────────────────────────┼────────┤
     │ canvas-utils.js (expanded)     │ ~380   │
     ├────────────────────────────────┼────────┤
     │ Total                          │ ~4,134 │
     └────────────────────────────────┴────────┘

      23
      24  ## Architecture
      25
      26 -**`canvas.js`** is organized by sections marked with `// ═══` banners:
      26 +### Module system
      27
      28 +All modules use `initXxx(deps)` dependency injection — no circular ES imports. `canvas.js` is the hub that wires everything togethe
         +r using forward-declared `let` variables and forwarding closures.
      29 +
      30 +```
      31 +canvas-utils.js     ← pure functions/constants, no deps
      32 +canvas-node-rendering.js  ← imports canvas-utils.js only
      33 +canvas-free-lines.js      ← imports canvas-utils.js only
      34 +canvas-links.js           ← imports canvas-utils.js only
      35 +canvas-nodes.js           ← no imports (all deps via injection)
      36 +canvas-dialogs.js         ← imports canvas-utils.js only
      37 +canvas.js                 ← imports all of the above; owns S, wires deps
      38 +```
      39 +
      40 +### `canvas.js` sections (marked with `// ═══` banners)
      41 +
      42  - **STATE** — Single `S` object holds all runtime state: nodes, links, freeLines, viewport, selection, drag, pan, edit mode, undo s
          tack, globalConfig, clipboard
      29 -- **VIEWPORT** — `applyVP()`, `s2c()`, `zoom()`, `fitAll()`, `jumpTo()` manage pan/zoom with CSS transform
      30 -- **HIGHLIGHT** — highlight.js integration, `highlight()` / `buildCodeHTML()`
      31 -- **NODES** — `addNode()`, `addBubble()`, `addFrame()`, `renderNode()`, `startEdit()`, `stopEdit()`, `removeNode()`
      32 -- **LINKS** — SVG bezier curves connecting nodes, `renderLinks()`, `createLink()`, `removeLink()`
      33 -- **FREE LINES** — freehand polyline/curve/straight-line strokes, `addFreeLine()`, `removeFreeLine()`, `renderFreeLines()`
      34 -- **UNDO** — snapshot-based undo stack (up to 10 steps), `pushUndo()`, `undo()`
      35 -- **DRAG/RESIZE** — pointer event handlers on nodes and the canvas wrapper
      43 +- **DOM REFS** — Raw element references captured at startup
      44 +- **MODE** — `setMode()`, `updateCursor()`
      45 +- **VIEWPORT** — `applyVP()`, `s2c()`, `c2s()`, `zoom()` manage pan/zoom with CSS transform
      46 +- **UTILS** — `setStatus()`, `ndEl(id)`
      47 +- **UNDO** — snapshot-based undo stack (up to 10 steps), `pushUndo()`, `undo()`, `suppressUndo()`
      48 +- **WIRING** — calls `initNodeRendering`, `initFreeLines`, `initLinks`, `initNodes`, `initDialogs` with forwarding closures to reso
         +lve mutual dependencies
      49 +- **PERSISTENCE** — `saveState()` / `loadState()` via `localStorage` (per-tab key), export/import as JSON, toolbar event listeners
      50 +- **CANVAS INTERACTION** — pointer event handlers for drag, resize, pan, zoom, marquee selection
      51  - **KEYBOARD** — global `keydown` handler for shortcuts (v/h mode, Del, Cmd+C/X/V/Z, Escape, etc.)
      37 -- **PERSISTENCE** — `saveState()` / `loadState()` via `localStorage` (per-tab key), export/import as JSON, Git snippet fetch via Gi
         -tHub raw URLs
      52 +- **INIT** — async IIFE that restores state from localStorage or URL param
      53 +- **TEST EXPORTS** — `globalThis.__canvasApp` (Vitest only)
      54
      39 -**Pure utility functions** (in `canvas-utils.js`; imported by `canvas.js`):
      55 +### `canvas-utils.js` exports
      56
      57  - `esc(s)` — HTML escape
      58  - `EXT_LANG`, `langFromPath(filePath)` — file extension → highlight.js language name
      59 +- `NODE_COLORS`, `FONT_PRESETS`, `FONT_SIZES` — color/font constants
      60 +- `LINK_COLORS`, `LINK_WIDTHS`, `LINK_DASHES` — link/line style constants
      61 +- `svgE(tag, attrs)` — SVG element factory
      62  - `injectAnchor(html, rawText, linkId)` — inject link-anchor span into highlighted HTML
      63 +- `injectTailAnchor(html, rawText, taid)` — inject tail-anchor span
      64  - `splitHtmlLines(html)`, `addLineNumbers(html, start)` — per-line HTML rendering with correct span handling
      65  - `roundedRectRayHit(...)` — ray vs. rounded-rect intersection (bubble tail geometry)
      66  - `anchorFpFromSide(r, side)` — exit point from an anchor element's bounding rect

⏺ 全テスト通過です。実装内容をまとめます。

  ---
  実装内容

  新しい Text ノードタイプをキャンバスに追加しました。

  使い方

  - ツールバーの 「T Text」 ボタンをクリックして配置
  - ダブルクリックでテキスト編集開始
  - 「•••」メニューから以下を変更可能:
    - Text Color — 10色のカラースウォッチ（White / Yellow / Green / Blue / Purple / Red / Orange / Cyan / Pink / Gray）
    - Font family — 既存のモノスペース/プロポーショナルフォント全プリセットに対応
    - Font size — 10〜96px（テキスト用の大きいサイズも含む）
    - Z-order（前面/背面に移動）

  動作の特徴

  - 背景なし・透明 — テキストがキャンバス上に直接浮かぶデザイン
  - ホバー時に薄い破線ボーダー、選択/編集時にテキスト色のボーダー
  - ノード全体をドラッグで移動可能（ヘッダー以外の部分からも）
  - コピー/ペースト・アンドゥ・保存/復元すべて対応

✻ Brewed for 6m 5s

⏺ 全体の構造を把握しました。現状の DOM レイヤーを整理すると:

  #wrap
    ├── #svg-tails   (バブルのしっぽ用 SVG)
    ├── #canvas      (ノード div たち — DOM 順で z-order)
    └── #svg-links   (リンク SVG — 常に全ノードの上)

  技術的には可能ですが、アーキテクチャ上の課題があります。

  #svg-links はすべてのノード div の上に位置する単一レイヤーなので、リンクが常に全ノードより上に描画されます。接続元ノードと同じ z-order
  にするには、リンクをノード div と同じ #canvas 内に配置し直す必要があります。

  ---
  実装方針（ペノード SVG アプローチ）:

  1. renderLinks() を変更し、全リンクを単一の #svg-links に描くのをやめる
  2. 各接続元ノードの div の 直後 に <svg class="node-link-svg"> を挿入する
  3. その SVG にそのノードからのリンクだけ描画する
  4. #canvas の中に入るので、ビューポートトランスフォームも共有される → canvas 座標系で描画できる

  必要な変更点:

  ┌──────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │         ファイル         │                                   変更内容                                   │
  ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ canvas-links.js          │ renderLinks() をペノード SVG 方式に書き換え。座標系を screen → canvas に変更 │
  ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ canvas-node-rendering.js │ reorderNode() 後に renderLinks() を呼ぶよう deps に追加                      │
  ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ canvas.js                │ initLinks / initNodeRendering の deps に canvas・ndEl・renderLinks を追加    │
  ├──────────────────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
  │ canvas.css               │ .node-link-svg の絶対配置スタイル追加                                        │
  └──────────────────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  懸念点:

  - getBoundingClientRect() で取れる anchor 位置がスクリーン座標なので s2c() で変換が必要
  - arrow マーカー (url(#arrow)) はドキュメント内で ID が一意であれば別 SVG から参照できる（モダンブラウザ対応）
  - ノードの z-order 変更時に renderLinks() を再呼び出しする必要がある

  ---
  実装しますか？変更はそこそこの規模（canvas-links.js の座標系リファクタ + 3ファイルへの小変更）になります。

  修正内容:

  ゼロサイズ SVG (width: 0; height: 0; overflow: visible) はブラウザによってコンテンツが描画されない問題がありました。バブルテール SVG
  と同じ方式に変更しました:

  - 接続元ノード + 全ターゲットノードのバウンディングボックスをパディング付きで計算
  - SVG の style.left/top/width/height を計算したボックスに合わせて設定
  - viewBox を "minX minY width height" に設定 → SVG ユーザー座標 = canvas 座標 が成立

  これで links が再び描画されます。z-order はノードの z-order に従います。

  insertAdjacentElement('afterend', svg) でリンク SVG はソースノード div の直後に挿入されます。両方が同じ z-index: 1 なので DOM
  順がスタッキングを決定します。これにより:

  - リンクはそのソースノードの上 (SVG が後ろにある → 上に描画)
  - それより後ろの DOM にある別のノードはリンクの上 (同 z-index で DOM 後方 → 上に描画)

 B. フォントコントロール バインディングの4重複 (canvas-node-rendering.js)

 sel-font-family change + inp-font-size change の約18行ブロックが4箇所:

 対処: bindFontControls(el, n, applyNodeFont, scheduleSave) ヘルパーに抽出

 querySelectorAll('.color-swatch') → active切替の約8行ブロックが3箇所:

 btn-edit-menu / menuWrap.classList.toggle('open') の約5行ブロックが4箇所:
 - renderBubbleContent (L321-327)

⏺ 調査と分析が完了しました。以下が結論です。

  ---
  現状のDOM管理

  規模: 約5,000行、154個のaddEventListener、44回のinnerHTML代入

  主な問題点:
  1. renderNode() が呼ばれるたびに el.innerHTML を全差し替えし、全イベントリスナーを再バインド（差分なし）
  2. コンテキストメニューのcreateElementループが3ファイルにわたって繰り返される（約15-20%がボイラープレート）
  3. 状態変更→DOM更新が完全に手動（宣言的バインディングなし）

  ---
  フレームワーク評価

  Option A: フレームワークなし、ユーティリティ抽出のみ

  - buildMenuItems(), bindClick(), applyNodeStyles() など5つのヘルパー関数を追加
  - 効果: 15-20%削減、リスクゼロ、ビルドステップ不要
  - 限界: innerHTML全差し替えの根本問題は残る

  Option B: Vue 3 (CDN importmap、ビルドなし)

  - 宣言的テンプレートで innerHTML = viewHTML(n) + リスナー再バインドを置き換え
  - Pinia で S オブジェクトを適切な状態管理に置き換え
  - 課題: ドラッグ/リサイズ/パン/ズームのstatemachineは引き続き手動ポインターイベントが必要。マイグレーション規模は大きい

  Option C: Lit (Web Components)

  - ノードタイプごとにカスタムエレメント化
  - 課題: Shadow DOMがCSSカスタムプロパティ（ノード色）と相性が悪い。リンク（2ノードまたがる）の扱いが煩雑

  Option D: Preact (3KB CDN)

  - 仮想DOM差分で innerHTML 全差し替えを解消
  - 課題: JSXはビルドステップなしでは使いにくい（htmタグドテンプレートが必要）

  ---
  推奨

  短期: Option A（ユーティリティ抽出）— アーキテクチャは既に良く設計されており（DI

 Framework Evaluation for Code Canvas DOM Management

 Context

 The app currently uses pure JavaScript for all DOM management. The user wants to evaluate whether adopting a 3rd-party framework would simplify
 the code. This is an analysis/recommendation — not an implementation task.

 ---
 Current DOM Management Summary

 Scale

 - 4,959 LOC across 7 core files (no build step, ES modules only)
 - 154 addEventListener calls, 44 innerHTML assignments, 51 createElement calls

 Key Patterns

 1. String template HTML — renderNode() regenerates full el.innerHTML on every render, then rebinds all event listeners from scratch
 2. Centralized mutable state (S) — single object, mutated in place; renders are triggered manually
 3. Dependency injection — all modules use initXxx(deps) pattern, no global state leakage
 4. Snapshot-based undo — structuredClone(S.nodes/links/freeLines), brute-force DOM clear + rebuild on undo
 5. Hybrid SVG + HTML — node positions are absolutely-positioned <div> elements; links/tails/free-lines are SVG paths in a separate overlay

 Pain Points

 - Full innerHTML replacement + listener rebinding on every render (no diffing)
 - ~15–20% boilerplate in context menus and event pairs across 3+ files
 - No declarative binding between state and DOM — every mutation requires explicit render call
 - Undo clears entire DOM and re-creates all elements from scratch

 ---
 Framework Evaluation

 Option A: No framework — refactor utilities only (minimal change)

 Extract ~5 helper utilities:
 - buildMenuItems(container, items, curValue, onSelect) — eliminate repeated createElement loops
 - bindClick(el, handler) — eliminates 40+ mousedown/stopPropagation + click pairs
 - applyNodeStyles(el, type, color) — consolidate repeated style.setProperty chains
 - bindAll(el, selectors) — query multiple selectors at once

 Estimated reduction: 15–20% fewer lines, minimal risk, no architecture change, no build step needed.

 Verdict: Low effort, immediate win, but doesn't address the root issue (full re-render + listener rebind).

 ---
 Option B: Vue 3 (CDN, Composition API, no build step)

 Vue 3 can be loaded from CDN as an ES module — no bundler required:
 <script type="importmap">{"imports": {"vue": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vue@3/dist/vue.esm-browser.js"}}</script>

 Would improve:
 - Declarative templates replace el.innerHTML = viewHTML(n) boilerplate
 - v-if/v-else handles edit/view mode switches cleanly
 - Granular reactivity — only changed nodes re-render (no full rebuild on undo)
 - @click/@mousedown binding eliminates listener rebinding on render
 - Pinia (also CDN-capable) provides proper state management replacing the mutable S object

 Would remain difficult:
 - Drag/resize/pan/zoom state machines still need custom pointer event handlers
 - SVG tail geometry (bubble tail svgE path building) is low-level and benefits little from templating
 - highlight.js integration: needs onMounted / watchEffect hook to re-run after render
 - ctags-wasm: needs async loading wrapper
 - Viewport CSS transform (#canvas pan/zoom) is still imperative and unrelated to Vue

 Estimated complexity:
 - Migration scope: large — all 5 init modules need to become components/composables
 - Risk: high (state machine interop, SVG coordinate systems, highlight.js timing)
 - Net simplification: moderate — templates reduce boilerplate, but framework overhead is non-trivial for a canvas interaction app

 ---
 Option C: Lit (CDN web components, no build step)

 <script type="module" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lit@3/index.js"></script>

 Each node type becomes a custom element (<code-node>, <bubble-node>, etc.).

 Would improve:
 - Each node type is self-contained (shadow DOM encapsulates styles + events)
 - html tagged templates with reactive properties replace manual innerHTML
 - Event listeners declared inside elements, not re-attached externally

 Would remain difficult:
 - Shadow DOM makes canvas-wide CSS custom properties (used for node colors) harder
 - Cross-element communication (links that reference two nodes) requires non-standard patterns
 - Drag/resize: pointer capture + document-level mousemove still needs manual coordination
 - Adds ~20KB runtime for unclear gain over the helper-utility approach

 Verdict: Slightly better fit than Vue for an element-per-node model, but shadow DOM isolation creates friction for this canvas-style app.

 ---
 Option D: Preact (CDN, JSX-optional, ~3KB)

 Can be loaded as ES module from CDN. Functional components with hooks.

 Would improve:
 - Virtual DOM diffing — no more full innerHTML replacement
 - useState/useReducer could replace mutable S cleanly
 - Small runtime (~3KB vs Vue's ~40KB)

 Would remain difficult:
 - Same pointer-event state machine issues as Vue
 - JSX requires either a build step or htm tagged templates (extra cognitive overhead)
 - React mental model requires lifting state up for drag/resize coordination between components

 Verdict: Best performance/size tradeoff of the framework options, but JSX ergonomics without build step are awkward.

 ---
 Recommendation

 Short term: Option A (utility extraction, no framework)

 The architecture is already well-structured (DI pattern, clear module boundaries, single state object). The main friction is tactical repetition,
 not fundamental design problems. Extracting 5 helper utilities eliminates 15–20% of boilerplate with zero migration risk and no build tooling
 changes.

 Long term: Vue 3 CDN (if simplification of conditional rendering is a priority)

 If the goal is to eliminate the el.innerHTML = viewHTML(n) + listener-rebind pattern, Vue 3 via CDN import map is the most practical framework
 option:
 - No build step needed (matches current architecture constraint)
 - Declarative templates directly replace the string-template + innerHTML pattern
 - Pinia replaces the mutable S object cleanly
 - The drag/resize/pan/zoom state machines can stay as composables using raw pointer events

 Migration would be phased:
 1. Replace one node type (e.g., text-node) as a Vue component to validate the pattern
 2. Migrate context menus (highest boilerplate density) as reusable components
 3. Migrate remaining node types and dialogs
 4. Replace S with Pinia store + undo plugin

 Not recommended: React (state lifting friction), Angular (overkill), Svelte (requires build step for full benefits).

 ---

 ├──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

 ├──────────────────────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤

      318 +export function buildMenuItems(container, items, curValue, { tag = 'button', baseClass, setContent, onSelect }) {

      320 +  for (const item of items) {

 Plan: Fix anchorMatchIdx incorrect occurrence index when line numbers are enabled

 Context

 The user reports that anchorMatchIdx is not working correctly: when selecting a specific occurrence of a repeated keyword to create a link, the
 link arrow originates from the wrong occurrence.

 Root cause confirmed: getCodeTextOffset in canvas-links.js computes a character offset that does not account for \n characters removed by
 addLineNumbers. When line numbers are enabled (showLineNumbers=true), addLineNumbers wraps each line in <span class="code-line"> and strips the \n
  separators from the DOM. The walker in getCodeTextOffset accumulates text-node lengths without the \n gaps, so it returns a compressed offset.
 getOccurrenceIdx then receives this shorter offset and finds the wrong match in the raw code (which still contains \n), returning an occurrence
 index that is too low.

 Example:
 - Raw code: "foo\nfoo\nfoo" — "foo" appears at positions 0, 4, 8
 - User selects the 3rd "foo" (line 3); DOM text nodes have no \n, so charOffset = 6
 - getOccurrenceIdx("foo\nfoo\nfoo", "foo", 6) → position 4 contains offset 6 → returns index 1 (wrong; should be 2)
 - With fix: charOffset = 8 → position 8 → returns index 2 ✓

 Critical files

 ┌─────────────────┬───────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │      File       │ Location  │                            Role                             │
 ├─────────────────┼───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ canvas-links.js │ ~line 373 │ getCodeTextOffset — the function to fix                     │
 ├─────────────────┼───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ canvas-links.js │ ~line 392 │ getOccurrenceIdx — downstream consumer (no change needed)   │
 ├─────────────────┼───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
 │ canvas-utils.js │ ~line 140 │ _injectSpans / injectAnchor — downstream (no change needed) │
 └─────────────────┴───────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

 Fix

 File: canvas-links.js, getCodeTextOffset function (~line 373–388)

 Detect .code-line boundary crossings and add 1 to total per crossing to restore the stripped \n characters:

 function getCodeTextOffset(pre, startNode, startOffset) {
   const walker = document.createTreeWalker(pre, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
     acceptNode(node) {
       return node.parentElement?.closest('.ln-num')
         ? NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT
         : NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
     },
   });
   let total = 0;
   let lastCodeLine = null;
   let node;
   while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
     // addLineNumbers removes \n between lines; compensate by adding 1
     // each time we cross into a new .code-line span.
     const codeLine = node.parentElement?.closest('.code-line');
     if (codeLine && codeLine !== lastCodeLine && lastCodeLine !== null) {
       total += 1;
     }
     lastCodeLine = codeLine;
     if (node === startNode) return total + startOffset;

     Plan: Fix anchorMatchIdx incorrect occurrence index when line numbers are enabled

     Context

     The user reports that anchorMatchIdx is not working correctly: when selecting a specific occurrence of a repeated keyword to create a link, the
      link arrow originates from the wrong occurrence.

     Root cause confirmed: getCodeTextOffset in canvas-links.js computes a character offset that does not account for \n characters removed by
     addLineNumbers. When line numbers are enabled (showLineNumbers=true), addLineNumbers wraps each line in <span class="code-line"> and strips the
      \n separators from the DOM. The walker in getCodeTextOffset accumulates text-node lengths without the \n gaps, so it returns a compressed
     offset. getOccurrenceIdx then receives this shorter offset and finds the wrong match in the raw code (which still contains \n), returning an
     occurrence index that is too low.

     Example:
     - Raw code: "foo\nfoo\nfoo" — "foo" appears at positions 0, 4, 8
     - User selects the 3rd "foo" (line 3); DOM text nodes have no \n, so charOffset = 6
     - getOccurrenceIdx("foo\nfoo\nfoo", "foo", 6) → position 4 contains offset 6 → returns index 1 (wrong; should be 2)
     - With fix: charOffset = 8 → position 8 → returns index 2 ✓

     Critical files

     ┌─────────────────┬───────────┬─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
     │      File       │ Location  │                            Role                             │
     ├─────────────────┼───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ canvas-links.js │ ~line 373 │ getCodeTextOffset — the function to fix                     │
     ├─────────────────┼───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ canvas-links.js │ ~line 392 │ getOccurrenceIdx — downstream consumer (no change needed)   │
     ├─────────────────┼───────────┼─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
     │ canvas-utils.js │ ~line 140 │ _injectSpans / injectAnchor — downstream (no change needed) │
     └─────────────────┴───────────┴─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

     Fix

     File: canvas-links.js, getCodeTextOffset function (~line 373–388)

     Detect .code-line boundary crossings and add 1 to total per crossing to restore the stripped \n characters:

     function getCodeTextOffset(pre, startNode, startOffset) {
       const walker = document.createTreeWalker(pre, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT, {
         acceptNode(node) {
           return node.parentElement?.closest('.ln-num')
             ? NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT
             : NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT;
         },
       });
       let total = 0;
       let lastCodeLine = null;
       let node;
       while ((node = walker.nextNode())) {
         // addLineNumbers removes \n between lines; compensate by adding 1
         // each time we cross into a new .code-line span.
         const codeLine = node.parentElement?.closest('.code-line');
         if (codeLine && codeLine !== lastCodeLine && lastCodeLine !== null) {
           total += 1;
         }
         lastCodeLine = codeLine;
         if (node === startNode) return total + startOffset;
         total += node.textContent.length;
       }
       return -1;
     }

     Why this is safe:
     - When showLineNumbers=false, there are no .code-line spans → codeLine is always null → condition never triggers → existing behavior preserved.
     - When showLineNumbers=true, +1 is added for each line boundary crossed (exactly the number of \n chars removed by addLineNumbers).
     - The lastCodeLine !== null guard prevents adding +1 for the very first line (no preceding \n).

     Secondary issue (not blocking, noted for awareness)

     _injectSpans deliberately skips injecting spans in the first line of the highlighted HTML (but counts them via countOnly when trackCount=true).
      If the user selects text that only appears on line 1, no data-lid-primary span is ever injected, so the link arrow falls back to the first
     available span on a later line. This is pre-existing intentional design and is not the issue the user is reporting, so it is not changed here.

     Verification

     1. Create a code block, enable Line No (line numbers).
     2. Enter code with the same word repeated on multiple lines (e.g., start).
     3. Select the 2nd or 3rd occurrence of that word.
     4. Create a link ("Link to…" or "New block").
     5. Confirm: the link arrow's origin highlights the occurrence that was selected, not the first occurrence.
     6. Also test without line numbers: behavior should be unchanged.
     7. Run npm test — all existing tests should pass (no test changes expected).

⏺ All 315 tests pass.

  Fix applied to canvas-links.js line 373: getCodeTextOffset now tracks the current .code-line span and adds 1 to the accumulated offset each time
  it crosses into a new line span.

  Why this fixes the bug: addLineNumbers converts \n characters into span boundaries (<span class="code-line">...</span>), removing them from the
  DOM's text content. The old code accumulated text-node lengths without those missing newlines, so the returned offset was "compressed" by one
  character per preceding line break. getOccurrenceIdx would then find a match at a lower index than the one actually selected. With the fix, the
  offset correctly mirrors the position in codeNode.code.

  Scope: Only affects selection on code blocks with line numbers enabled (showLineNumbers=true). When line numbers are off, there are no .code-line
  spans, so codeLine is always null and the new code path never triggers.

⏺ Root cause identified. In injectTailAnchor, the insidePattern is:

  /^<span[^>]+class="[^"]*\b(?:link-anchor|tail-anchor)\b/

  This blocks injection inside both link-anchor and tail-anchor spans. When the "Attach bubble tail here" flow is triggered from the anchor context
  menu, the text (e.g. foo) is already wrapped in a link-anchor span after injectAnchor runs. Then injectTailAnchor sees insideAnchor = true and
  skips injection entirely — so no tail-anchor span is ever created, and renderBubbleTail finds nothing.

  Fix: allow injectTailAnchor to inject inside link-anchor spans. Only block inside existing tail-anchor spans (to prevent double-wrapping).

⏺ 315 tests pass.

  Summary of what was fixed and why:

  Root cause: injectTailAnchor used insidePattern = /^<span[^>]+class="[^"]*\b(?:link-anchor|tail-anchor)\b/ — this prevented injection inside both
  link-anchor and tail-anchor spans.

  When the "Attach bubble tail here" anchor context menu is used, attachTailToText sets bubble.tailAnchorText = text where text is the same text as
  the link anchor. In buildCodeHTML, injectAnchor runs first and wraps that text in <span class="link-anchor" ...>. Then injectTailAnchor sees the
  text is inside a link-anchor span and skips it — producing no tail-anchor span at all. renderBubbleTail's
  querySelector('.tail-anchor[data-taid="X"]') found nothing.

  Fix: Changed insidePattern in injectTailAnchor to /^<span[^>]+class="[^"]*\btail-anchor\b/ — only blocks injection inside existing tail-anchor
  spans. Now tail-anchor is injected inside link-anchor spans, producing the valid nested structure:
  <span class="link-anchor" data-lid="1"><span class="tail-anchor" data-taid="2">foo</span></span>
  renderBubbleTail finds the tail-anchor and correctly positions the bubble tail.

⏺ 全テスト通過しました。変更内容を説明します。

  バグの原因

  getOccurrenceIdx の判定条件：
  charOffset >= m.index && charOffset < m.index + text.length

  ユーザーが単語の直前（先頭の空白など）から選択を始めると、sel.toString().trim() でテキストは正規化されるが、range.startOffset
  は空白の位置を指したまま。そのため charOffset < m.index となり、どのマッチも charOffset >= m.index を満たせず、フォールバックの return 0
  が返っていた。

  修正内容

  canvas-links.js:404の getOccurrenceIdx:

  - 条件を緩和: charOffset < m.index + text.length — マッチの範囲内だけでなく、直前から来ても正しいインデックスを返す（先頭空白のトリム対応）
  - フォールバックを修正: return 0 → return idx > 0 ? idx - 1 : -1 — charOffset
  が全マッチの末尾を超えた場合（末尾空白のトリム）は最後のマッチのインデックスを返す。マッチが一つも無い場合は -1

  これにより、選択の開始位置が単語の直前や直後にわずかにずれても、正しい出現インデックスが anchorMatchIdx に保存されます。

⏺ これで原因と修正箇所が確定しました。

  バグ1の原因: injectTailAnchor が同じ taid でテキストの全出現箇所にスパンを注入し、tail レンダラーが querySelector で最初の要素を取るため。

  バグ2の原因: 同じテキストで2つ目のバブルを作ると、全出現箇所が1つ目のバブルのスパンで既に覆われているため2つ目の injectTailAnchor
  が何も注入できず、tail が DOM アンカーではなく tailX/tailY の初期値（少しずれた位置）を使う。

  修正方針: injectTailAnchor に tailMatchIdx を追加し、指定した出現インデックスの箇所だけにスパンを注入する（リンクアンカーと同じ考え方）。

  バグ1の修正: _injectSpans に targetIdx パラメータを追加。injectTailAnchor は tailMatchIdx
  を受け取り、その出現インデックスの箇所にだけスパンを注入（他の出現はそのままのテキストを出力）。これにより
  querySelector('.tail-anchor[data-taid="X"]') が必ず正しい1つの要素を返す。

  に対応する出現箇所だけにスパンを注入するため、互いに干渉しない。

      75 +- **Node data model**: Each node in `S.nodes[]` is a plain object. Code nodes: `{ id, x, y, w, h, code, lang, title, filePath, show
         +LineNumbers, lineNumberStart, color }`. Bubble nodes: `{ id, type: 'bubble', x, y, w, h, text, tailX, tailY, color, showTail, tailA
         +nchorId, tailAnchorText, tailAnchorFromId, tailAnchorMatchIdx }` — `tailAnchorMatchIdx` is the 0-based occurrence index of the anch

         +}`. Text nodes: `{ id, type: 'text', x, y, w, h, text, textColor, fontFamily, fontSize }`.
      76  - **Rendering**: `renderNode(n)` dispatches to `renderFrameContent()`, `renderTextContent()`, `renderBubbleContent()`, or the code-
          block view/edit HTML generators. Nodes are never re-rendered in-place; `stopEdit()` re-renders the whole element.
      77  - **Edit mode**: `startEdit(id)` swaps the highlighted `<pre>` for a `<textarea>`; `stopEdit()` reads the textarea and re-renders.
      78  - **Links**: Created via text selection → tooltip click flow. Stored as `{ id, fromId, toId, text, stroke, strokeWidth, dash }` in
          `S.links[]`; rendered as SVG paths on every viewport change.
